===Pokémon Adventures===
Sonia debuted in ''[[PASS06|Watch Out!! Strong Rivals]]''. She encountered her grandmother [[Professor Magnolia]] and her assistants [[Henry Sword|Henry]], [[Casey Shield|Casey]], and [[Marvin]] at the [[Motostoke|Budew Drop Inn]]. Sonia explained the inn's statue and its connection to the [[Darkest Day]]. When Magnolia's trailer broke down, she asked Sonia to go investigate the geoglyph at [[Turffield]] in her place. She later concluded the geoglyph was a drawing of the Darkest Day.

In ''[[PASS09|Splish Splash!! Gigantamax Battle]]'', Sonia and Henry had dinner with [[Rose]] at the Captain's Table restaurant. Noting that Sonia was investigating the [[Dynamax]] phenomenon, Rose invited her to investigate the vault in [[Hammerlocke]]. Afterward, Sonia received a call from [[Nessa]], who vented about her losses against Henry and Casey.

In ''[[PASS13|Glittering!! The Tapestry in the Vault]]'', while in Hammerlocke, Sonia angered a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Oranguru}} when she accidentally stepped on its fan. After being saved by Henry and [[Raihan]], Sonia and Henry entered the Hammerlocke vault. Inside were four tapestries, each depicting events from the Darkest Day. Sonia and Henry noticed the tapestries portrayed two heroes instead of the singular hero like on the statue in the Budew Drop Inn. Sonia chose to stay and do more investigating while Henry went ahead with the others.

In ''[[PASS17|Stealth!! Infiltrate the Energy Plant]]'', when an earthquake struck Hammerlocke, Sonia went to see if the [[Energy Plant]] was unharmed. She found [[Leon]] attempting to enter the building and check on Rose's safety, only to be blocked by a pair of {{tc|Macro Cosmos's|Macro Cosmos}} employees. When Leon spotted her, Sonia attempted to flee, but was stopped when Raihan arrived. Raihan told Sonia and Leon to move the citizens to a safer location while he went inside to see if Rose was unharmed.

In ''[[PASS19|Crunch!! Snowy Battle]]'', Sonia arrived in [[Circhester]], where a fifth tapestry was said to be held at the Bob's Your Uncle restaurant. She later took Henry's group to the restaurant and told them what she had found out. She speculated the tapestry was thrown away on purpose to keep a piece of Galar's history out of public knowledge. 

In ''[[PASS22|Grrr!! Noble Kidnappers]]'', Sonia planned to meet up with Henry's group and give them information she uncovered on [[Sordward]] and [[Shielbert]], the thieves that stole Casey's Pokémon. Just as her [[Flying Taxi]] approached the meet-up spot, it was shot out of the sky by a {{p|Klinklang}}. After Leon rescued Sonia, he and Raihan took her and the {{tc|Cabbie}} to a hospital in Hammerlocke. The camera containing the information meant for Casey was given to [[Piers]] for safekeeping until it reached its destination. Sonia later awakened at the hospital, where she revealed to Leon that Sordward and Shielbert were working together with Rose.
